name: Kugenuma Ryou
source:
Even though she's the youngest of the bunch, Ryou naturally takes charge when it comes to work. This discipline comes from a traditional and strict upbringing. With such a background, though, it's odd that she would work in such a revealing atmosphere, but it seems to have given her plenty of hidden cravings.

[From [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/580736-do-you-like-horny-bunnies/faqs/33784]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
